parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance IDs.

parameters.name: DBProxyEngineType
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: SwitchTime
parameters.description:
The time at which to perform the upgrade. Format: *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z (UTC time).

> This parameter is required only when **UpgradeTime** is set to **SpecifyTime**.

parameters.name: TargetMinorVersion
parameters.description: The new minor version of the instance. You can find the new minor version from the **TargetMinorVersion** parameter in the response of the [DescribeDBProxyTargetVersion](~~API.DescribeDBProxyTargetVersion~~) operation.

parameters.name: UpgradeTime
parameters.description:
The upgrade time. Valid values:

- **MaintainTime** (Default): The upgrade runs during the [maintenance window](~~610402~~).

- **Immediate**: The upgrade runs immediately.

- **SpecifyTime**: The upgrade runs at a specified time.
